title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in IoPt, implemented by partners Adalah, B'Tselem, PCHR, CFTA, EAPPI and EJ YMCA, supports civil society to demand accountability, equal rights and justice and to support Palestinian communities to have their rights met. The objectives of the grant are to support marginalised Palestinian communities to claim their rights, with a particular focus on women and marginalised groups, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society. Objectives: Objective 1 - Rights Holders: Rights holders (women, men, groups, organisations, communities and peoples) are taking action to advance their rights Outcomes: Structural enablers of injustice and root causes of poverty are being tackled through i)more resilient civil society actors who are able to influence local and international decision makers in their demands for accountability, equal rights and justice, ii) more resilient Palestinian communities as a result of having their rights met and through community-based action to strengthen agency and shift power
